global_layer.context: A single continuous close-up in a bright kitchen of hot coffee being poured into a glass mug.
global_layer.description: Coffee streams from a gooseneck kettle-style server into a clear glass mug, swirling, then cream is poured in and blooms.

aesthetics.color_scheme: dark coffee, white cream, clear glass, pale marble counter

audio_baseline.ambience: a quiet kitchen in the morning, a clock ticking softly

objects_static.relative_size: fills the middle third of the frame

lighting_baseline.direction: from behind the mug, backlighting the liquid
lighting_baseline.source_consistency: the lighting holds steady for the full clip

environment_baseline.background_setting: a white marble countertop and a blurred bright kitchen window

segment_basic_info.segment_description: A thin stream of dark coffee pours into the empty glass mug and fills it two thirds.

camera_delta.focus: the stream and the liquid surface

causal_events.effect_outcome: the level rises with swirling foam and small bubbles
causal_events.physics: the liquid swirls in a vortex, a thin crema forms at the top, steam lifts

special_audio_events.sound_description: a gentle liquid pouring sound rising in pitch as the mug fills

segment_basic_info.segment_description: Cream pours in from above and blooms into the coffee in slow white clouds.

causal_events.effect_outcome: white plumes billow and curl downward through the dark coffee
causal_events.physics: the denser cream sinks and swirls into marbled turbulent clouds
